blocks.text: This sheet accompanies the data export prepared for a patient access request. It records the export reference, the integrity digest of the archive and whether Part 2 redaction was applied. To confirm the archive is complete and unaltered, compute the SHA-256 digest of the file received and compare it with the value below.
42 CFR Part 2 redaction was applied to the export: substance use disorder treatment records the patient has not consented to release were excluded.
